name: THSV StreamBridge - Accessibility Captions
author: surakage
description: Relays recognized native Voice Control dictation to the Accessibility Captions add-on when speech WebSocket notifications are unavailable.
triggerSafety: Attach only Voice Control > Dictation and/or Voice Control > Log. Keep it outside the speech playback queue. The relay writes no audio or transcript files.
verificationStatus: Source and package structure tested; live microphone caption acceptance remains creator-verified.
